speaker: Patient
text: This cough has been with me for over six months, and it seems to get much worse at night. I also feel quite breathless when I try to do physical work, like driving or carrying heavy loads. I don't think it's specifically triggered by dust, but the cold air does seem to make the coughing fit stronger. However, the Holter monitor integration is down. speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that detail. Since the cough is worse at night and you have breathlessness on exertion, have you noticed any morning congestion, wheezing, or a history of allergies? Also, do you have any nighttime awakenings due to these symptoms?

text: I do have a history of seasonal allergies, and I often wake up in the middle of the night coughing or feeling congested in the morning. The phlegm is usually white, and while I don't have chest pain or cough up blood, the shortness of breath really limits what I can do during my day.
